Python 3.13 - What's New, Support Lifecycle & EOL - VersionLog

versionlog.com/python/3.13/     2026-09-23T00:00:00.0000000
What Is New in Python 3.13 Python 3.13 is a landmark release on two fronts: it ships the first official experimental free-threaded build (no GIL), and an experimental JIT compiler -- both opt-in. For everyday users, the REPL gets a complete rewrite with multiline editing and color, the PEP 594 "dead batteries" are removed en masse, and import startup times improve across many stdlib modules.
